channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's vulnerability landscape is characterized by a high volume of critical remote code execution and privilege escalation flaws targeting foundational enterprise and operational technology environments. Microsoft ecosystems face pervasive risks, including unauthenticated RCE in Windows SMB and Print Spooler, extensive SQL Server heap overflows allowing database takeover, and systemic authorization failures within SharePoint and Office applications. Network infrastructure is heavily impacted by multiple authentication bypasses and command injections in Fortinet devices, while cloud and development sectors report dangerous authorization gaps in Azure services and remote code execution vulnerabilities in Visual Studio Code that threaten CI/CD pipelines and developer workstations.
